high_level_description: This image appears to be taken at Chennai International Airport on December 24, 2024. The setting is an indoor corridor with a modern design, featuring a ceiling with recessed lighting and glass panels on the left side, possibly leading to another part of the airport or a terminal. In the foreground, there is a person standing and facing the camera. This individual is wearing a dark blue hoodie with yellow accents, dark jeans, and white sneakers. They have a yellow backpack slung over one shoulder and are holding a book in their hands. The person is also wearing glasses and has short hair.
